theorems.name: Submission.poincare_set_mean_deviation_sq_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ), MeasurableSet s → volume s ≠ ∞ → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict s) → ∫⁻ x in s, ‖f x - ⨍ y in s, f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (volume s)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in s, ∫⁻ y in s, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2
